featured_techniques.technique: Executive coaching for C-suite and CX leadership
Five competencies framework for CX transformation

sections.description: This section introduces the speaker's new book Chief Customer Officer 2.0, highlights a decade of coaching C-suite teams and emerging CX leaders, references a deliberate roadmap since the first book, and states that the book presents all-new content built around five competencies for leading CX transformation.
sections.title: Introduction and core premise

summary: In this 43-second YouTube clip, Jeanne Bliss announces the release of Chief Customer Officer 2.0 and reflects on a decade of coaching C-suite leaders and emerging Chief Customer Officers or VPs of Customer Experience. She frames the new book as a culmination of a developing roadmap for customer experience (CX) transformation, noting that the content is all new and organized around five competencies intended to guide CX initiatives within organizations.
title: Chief Customer Officer 2.0: Book Release and Five-Competency CX Transformation
